::: {.area-page-hero}
::: {.area-page-copy}
[Project Myogenesis](../projects/project-myogenesis-iss.qmd), our human muscle stem-cell experiment aboard the International Space Station during Axiom Mission 4, anchors this research area.
We pair the rare opportunity of spaceflight with ground simulation so that observations from orbit
can become repeatable biological questions in the laboratory.
:::
